declarations.coverage: Intentionally empty: this declaration changes remote GitHub configuration through its canonical-labels and pull-request-integration fixes and checks optional repository-owned reviewer data without writing it, so it covers no project-content paths. The repository is lutzseverino/scriptorium, the only github.com repository its Git remotes name; `gh repo view --json visibility` reports PUBLIC, and `gh variable list` reports no repository-level variables, so REPO_CANON_RUNS_ON is unset (the hosted default). The repository is owned by a user account, so no organization-level variable can supply a value. The owner authorized configuring this repository's GitHub settings through gh with this session's admin credentials.

Intentionally empty: the repository holds one package, `@lutzseverino/scriptorium`, whose only manifest is the root package.json, with src/ and test/ at the root and no workspace or build configuration naming another component. The package is the repository itself, so its README is the root README.md, which the repository-readme declaration owns; there is no non-root Project and so no non-root README to propose. The README.md files under docs/ are documentation indexes owned by the documentation scope.
